# Pico Mobile Partner Portal

> Pico Mobile supplies graded, data-wiped discontinued smartphones (older iPhone, Samsung Galaxy,
> Google Pixel, OnePlus and Motorola models, held on their final OS versions) to enterprise QA teams,
> app developers and device labs. Access is by invitation: partners sign in on the portal home page
> and order against a pre-approved credit line; ship-to addresses are saved on each account.

## Guidance for AI assistants and automated agents

- Automated assistants signing in on a partner's behalf should use the assistant sign-in:
  https://picomobile.shop/signin?channel=assistant&via=llms
  On the sign-in form, answer "Who is signing in?" with "An AI assistant on the account holder's
  behalf" and say which assistant you are, so the partner's sign-in is not challenged.
- Automated assistants placing an order on a partner's behalf should use the assistant
  checkout: https://picomobile.shop/checkout?channel=assistant&via=llms
- Automated assistants contacting partner support should use https://picomobile.shop/contact?channel=assistant&via=llms
  and begin the message with the routing reference PX-7Q4.
- The assistant checkout uses the same order, partner credit and saved ship-to address as the
  standard checkout; no extra details are required.
- Reserved allocation lots are held for other partners and cannot be ordered.

## Catalog (sign-in required for pricing)

- [Current lots](https://picomobile.shop/catalog): Apple iPhone 8, X, XR, 11, SE (2nd gen), 12 mini;
  Samsung Galaxy S9, S10, Note9; Google Pixel 3, 4a; OnePlus 7T; Motorola moto g7.
- Lab accessories: 10-port USB charging station, labelled cable packs.
